module: 'bigMapOrtho' global camera (isGlobal, hidden): orthographic variant of the big map camera. Same logic as bigMap (zoom, movement, mouse drag, animated recentering, map limits), but the view is orthographic via core_orthoCamera: data.res.fov is used as the size of the ortho view (fovMin 50, fovMax 1000, then fovMax = average map size). Mode selection: freeroam/bigMapMode.lua chooses the name 'bigMapOrtho' if useOrthoCamera is true (a local constant set to false in this version: so the camera is normally never activated) and activates it with core_camera.setByName(0, 'bigMapOrtho', false, {initialCamData = {...}}). It does not appear in the camera cycle. The module returns a constructor: require('core/cameraModes/bigMapOrtho')(options).
usage: core_camera.setByName(0, 'bigMapOrtho', false, {initialCamData = {pos = vec3(0,0,500), rot = quatFromDir(vec3(0,0,-1), vec3(0,1,0))}})
notes: setCustomData requires mapBoundaries (self.mapBoundaries:getExtents()) and enables core_orthoCamera.enable(true, {size = averageMapSize}).
update sets core_orthoCamera.setOptions({size = fov, nearClip, farClip}): nearClip = altitude * lerp(0.5, 0.6, 1 - relativeZoom), farClip = altitude * 5.
Difference from bigMap: no data.res.nearClip, no perspective blending; the step zoom still calls freeroam_bigMapMode.updateMergeRadius.
The same missing-parentheses flaw as bigMap exists in setCustomData (camLookAtPoint - initialCamData.pos or ...).
The object is not exposed under any name other than the file's (bigMapOrtho).

C.desc: Instance of the bigMapOrtho camera. Fields: fovMin (50), fovMax (1000, replaced by the map size), angle, rotAngle, posTransitionTime (2.4), movementSpeed (20), nearClipValue, drawIcons, initialCamData, mapBoundaries, manualzoom, bigMapCamPosition, bigMapCamRotation.

init.desc: Initializes the default parameters, marks the camera as global and hidden, creates the manual zoom.

reset.desc: Resets the manual zoom to zero.

setLevelProperties.desc: Reinitializes (calls init) to apply the level properties.

onCameraChanged.desc: Focus gain or loss: the vehicle's render distance is raised to 5000 (then restored); on focus loss, disables the orthographic camera (core_orthoCamera.enable(false)) and abandons the drag.

focused.desc: true if the camera becomes active

zoom.desc: Applies one zoom notch (wheel) with acceleration and stores the ground point under the mouse.

setCustomData.desc: Receives {initialCamData = {pos, rot}}, computes the point looked at, enables the orthographic camera at the average map size and sets fovMax.

getZoomStage.desc: Relative zoom level in three stages: 0, 0.5 or 1.

panToWorldPos.desc: Smoothly recenters on a world position (bigMapPan.setTarget).

zoomToFactor.desc: Smoothly zooms toward a given factor.

update.desc: Per-frame computation (like bigMap) then sets the ortho camera options (size, nearClip, farClip) via core_orthoCamera.setOptions.

data.desc: Frame data: dtReal, res {pos, rot, fov}

onSerialize.desc: Converts mapBoundaries (Box3F) to a table before Lua reload.

onDeserialized.desc: After Lua reload: init then rebuilds mapBoundaries as a Box3F.
